history.title: What happened to it
history.description: Every committed transaction that touched one entity, newest first. Each is returned as the patch it applied — the components it wrote, or `$delete` if it deleted the entity — stamped with who wrote it, when, and through what instrument. The record is written inside the transaction that wrote, so this gives attribution and a diff with no version table; it covers changes made since this graph started journaling.

entity.description: the entity whose history to read — an id, a name, or an eid

limit.description: at most this many transactions, counting back from the newest
